items.stem: A toy is in the form of a cone of radius 42 cm mounted on a hemisphere of the same radius. The slant height of the cone is 58 cm. Find the total surface area of the toy (π = 22/7).
items.markingKey: TSA = CSA of cone + CSA of hemisphere = πrl + 2πr² = 7656 + 11088 = 18744 cm².
